findings.reason: Confirmed as a conflict between the required all-degree interface and the binding supplier scope, not as literally unrouted mathematics. ANSCHUTZ-LEBRAS-23 item /97 and accepted route 7 already assign the complete package to A4, but native A4 explicitly limits its realizations to degree one and accepted RS-02 narrows A4 to a keeps contract that does not include the all-degree theorem; protocol section 15 requires following that contract. Reconcile the route with the maintained A4/RS-02 scope, or assign a justified extension importing A4, and record finite local freeness, base change and the alternating/exterior-algebra isomorphism as explicit outputs. The proposed proof strategy needs correction: FARB-KISIN-WOLFSON-24 /065 is characteristic-zero mod-p étale cohomology, not the relative de Rham/Hodge theorem over a general base; its overall review is revise, so route 17 is not applied by the queue despite its individual accept verdict. The two sources are not contradictory proofs of the same theorem. Use ALB Proposition 4.5.1 and its cited BBM 2.5.2 as the de Rham source; retain the inspected bounded-prism/p-adic-completion hypotheses unless broader BBM generality is verified. Over a nonaffine base state the theorem for higher direct-image sheaves, not global modules. Do not obtain arbitrary-base finite local freeness from complex uniformization alone. Keep the main theorem unbuilt; accepted routing is a requirement, not a library implementation.
